title: Excel Foundations
summary: C1 takes a complete beginner to confident everyday use: entering and formatting data, writing formulas that copy correctly, and organising, printing and sharing a workbook.
outcomes: Find your way around any workbook quickly, with mouse and keyboard.
Enter, edit, fill and correct data, including dates and numbers.
Format sheets that other people can read, including Indian number formats.
Write formulas with SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX and COUNT, and fix the common errors.
Copy formulas correctly using relative, absolute and mixed references.
Organise data as tables, then sort, filter and validate it.
Print, export, share and protect a workbook.
